Note: an earlier attempt used a CIN I had constructed myself (U72900PN2015PTC157456) - that value was NOT sourced and is deliberately excluded from this record; it must not be treated as real. The claimed state is empty in the input, so state_registered vs state_claimed cannot be compared. Role left as 'unknown' - the declared HS 997331 is a services classification (business support/other professional services), which is consistent with a software/SaaS-type provider rather than a goods manufacturer, but this is an inference from the HS code only, not from any registry document. No rejection applied: there is no evidence the entity does not exist, is struck off, liquidated or bankrupt - the absence of data is a tooling limitation, not a negative finding. Recommended next step: re-run with a working search backend, or verify manually on the MCA portal (mca.gov.in company master data) and the GST portal search by trade name, then populate CIN, PAN (4th character gives holder type: P=individual, C=company, F=firm, H=HUF, A=AOP, T=trust), GSTIN and status, and pull FY25/FY26 revenue from audited filings only.
